selection.ownership: Zixflow operates an international CRM/engagement SaaS at api.zixflow.com. US presence: 16192 Coastal Hwy, Lewes, Delaware. Operating company ZIXFLOW PRIVATE LIMITED, No.26 Laskar Hosur Rd Adugodi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560029, India (CIN U72900KA2022PTC167283). Privacy policy hosts EU customers in Frankfurt. Not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official Zixflow API introduction and Bearer authentication, GET collections, GET collections/{id}, GET lists, GET lists/{id}, GET workspace-members, privacy/hosting (US/EU/India), and dated incident search for Zixflow / zixflow.com security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Official unauthorized examples are HTTP 401 {status:false,message}. Zixflow AI x-api-key APIs are a different host. No qualifying current unresolved Zixflow customer-data compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official CRM API at https://api.zixflow.com/api/v1 with Authorization Bearer. GET /workspace-members is the pinned validator. Collection and list GETs are documented reads. Query POSTs and writes omitted. Official 401 examples carry status:false; native uses HTTP status. Pinned source additionally rejects HTTP 200 status:false, which native cannot express because false does not trip bodyErrorPaths and success messages are non-empty strings.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Zixflow / zixflow.com security breach coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
